description: Synthetic retrieval-eval corpus. Three tenant archetypes (business, personal, ministry-shaped). Nothing here is real: every person, company and number is invented. Keys are stable identifiers referenced by eval/retrieval/gold/*.json. createdAtOffsetDays is relative to the day the seed runs (negative = past) and is stored in metadata because the public API does not accept createdAt. Pairs where `supersedes` is set exercise the update slice via PATCH /memories/:id { supersedes }.
